name: io.github.africanmarketos591/mvr-api
title: MVR API - Minimum Viable Relationships
description: Read-only MVR preflight for trust, permission, evidence gaps, and African market-entry readiness.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.attribution: Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR), originated by Farouk Mark Mukiibi, African Market OS.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.semanticIdentity: Relational-readiness and market-permission decision governance for AI agents.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.profileBoundary: Registry entry is a keyless five-tool read-only sandbox preflight; other profiles are separate.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.useWhen: Use when an AI agent assesses market entry, launch, funding, partnership, pilot, or scale readiness in African or other high-context markets.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.doNotUseFor: Do not use as legal approval, credit underwriting, regulatory certification, or autonomous execution authority.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.allowedUse: Non-commercial evaluation only for the public sandbox. Production and commercial use require authorization.
